Criteria:
- P1: Dependencies: does every step come after the steps whose results it needs? If a requirement of step B uses something that a requirement of step A creates (a name, a command, a connection, data, a schema, a part that is reused), B needs A. Name each missing dependency as 'A -> B' (A must finish before B) and say what B needs from A.
- P2: Coverage: is each requirement's work done by build and test steps that really do it?
- P3: Acceptance criteria: are they concrete and checkable?
- P4: Granularity: no duplicated steps and no step split into trivial pieces?

The research, verify, design and review steps and the order research -> design -> build -> test -> documents -> review come from a template and are correct. Steps listed as 'after: X' already depend on X (directly); a dependency through other steps also counts.

Material:
Requirements:
R1 [must] The server must accept at least 10 clients connected at the same time.
R2 [must] Each client must choose a unique nickname when it connects.
R3 [must] A message sent by one client must be delivered to every other connected client.
R4 [must] The server shall announce when a client joins or leaves the chat.
R5 [should] Clients should be able to send a private message with the command /msg.
R6 [could] The server may keep a history of the last 50 messages for new clients.
R7 [must] The server must not crash when a client disconnects without warning.
R8 [should] Messages should reach other clients within one second on a local network.

Plan steps:
research [research] Research the approach (requirements: -; after: -) criteria: every research question has an answer with sources; the answers name the options considered
verify [research] Check the research findings (requirements: -; after: research) criteria: every claim the design uses is supported by a source; unsupported claims are marked
design [design] Design the solution (requirements: -; after: verify) criteria: each part has a module and an interface; the skeleton runs; the design follows the constraints; C1 respected: Use Python 3.11 and the standard library only.
T1 [implement] Implement server core for TCP connections (requirements: R1; after: design) criteria: The server must accept at least 10 clients connected at the same time.
T2 [implement] Add unique nickname registration (requirements: R2; after: T1) criteria: Each client must choose a unique nickname when it connects.
T6 [implement] Handle abrupt client disconnects gracefully (requirements: R7; after: T1) criteria: The server must not crash when a client disconnects without warning.
T7 [test] Test server capacity and stability (requirements: R1; after: T1) criteria: The server must accept at least 10 clients connected at the same time.
T3 [implement] Implement broadcast and join/leave announcements (requirements: R3, R4; after: T2) criteria: A message sent by one client must be delivered to every other connected client.; The server shall announce when a client joins or leaves the chat.
T12 [test] Test robustness on abrupt disconnects (requirements: R7; after: T6) criteria: The server must not crash when a client disconnects without warning.
T8 [test] Test nickname uniqueness enforcement (requirements: R2; after: T2) criteria: Each client must choose a unique nickname when it connects.
T4 [implement] Add private messaging command (requirements: R5; after: T3) criteria: Clients should be able to send a private message with the command /msg.
T9 [test] Test broadcast and join/leave announcements (requirements: R3, R4; after: T3) criteria: A message sent by one client must be delivered to every other connected client.; The server shall announce when a client joins or leaves the chat.
T5 [implement] Store last 50 messages for history (requirements: R6; after: T3) criteria: The server may keep a history of the last 50 messages for new clients.
T13 [test] Measure message latency under one second (requirements: R8; after: T4, T5, T6) criteria: Messages should reach other clients within one second on a local network.
T10 [test] Test private messaging functionality (requirements: R5; after: T4) criteria: Clients should be able to send a private message with the command /msg.
T11 [test] Test message history delivery (requirements: R6; after: T5) criteria: The server may keep a history of the last 50 messages for new clients.
T14 [document] Prepare README (requirements: -; after: T7, T8, T9, T10, T11, T12, T13) criteria: D2 exists: README; it matches the finished, tested work
T15 [document] Prepare Design and test report (requirements: -; after: T7, T8, T9, T10, T11, T12, T13) criteria: D3 exists: Design and test report; it matches the finished, tested work
review [review] Final review (requirements: -; after: T14, T15) criteria: every must requirement is met; every deliverable is present; C1 respected: Use Python 3.11 and the standard library only.; C2 respected: Use TCP sockets; do not use a web framework.
